propositions: A deterministic clarity floor must be narrowed to only rules with zero false positives in signed/completed historical tickets; rules with legitimate counterexamples must be demoted to advisory only.
Exact duplicate Acceptance Criteria items do not make plans ambiguous or unexecutable; the hard rule rejecting them is a false positive and must be removed.

Bare unresolved sentinels (TBD/TODO/FIXME/???) only constitute a hard clarity failure when they occupy structural assignment positions (after colons, equals, or copulas), not in removal/negation assertions.
File-impact structural validation (nonempty path and reason) belongs to write-schema integrity at mutation boundaries, not to plan clarity scoring.
Citation validation for [rebar:id] prerequisites must be invoked only when claiming absent file/symbol creation credit, not for ordinary provenance, transitive context, or downstream references.
